task: resume the canonical lab from a newly cloned clean main and select permitted work
measurement_notes: Both conditions use the same detached clean main snapshot and the same mandatory startup document set.
The baseline omits only checkpoint inspection; coverage is a separate common workflow check.

All operational agent-visible checkpoint output is counted. The existing stdlib tool required no incremental setup; its local hash input is reported separately and not equated with model-context bytes.
Evaluation logging is required by lab policy, not by normal checkpoint use. Existing implementation maintenance is not amortized; including it could only worsen this negative result.
This clean fresh-clone condition does not represent a dirty or long-lived worktree and cannot establish latency or task-success effects.
